text:
ryan: quick bug report — when using redwood AsyncClient with opentelemetry, my background tasks lose the trace context. parent span exists, but child spans for client calls are new roots.
sam: that usually means contextvars didn't propagate into the new task (python 3.10). are you using asyncio.create_task?
ryan: yes. minimal repro: parent span -> asyncio.create_task(client.generate(...)) -> downstream call shows different trace id.
maya: we saw this too. two asks: (1) doc note explaining create_task caveat, (2) an SDK helper that schedules coros while preserving context (users shouldn't need to copy_context manually).
sam: plan: add `AsyncClient.create_task_preserve_context(coro)` and a small example under examples/telemetry that wires OTEL console exporter. also will add a config flag `propagate_traceparent_header` default false for infra teams.
ryan: one more — type stubs for AsyncClient methods claim they return `str` in some versions. IDEs/mypy get annoyed. can we fix return types to reflect coroutines / dataclasses?
sam: yep we'll update stubs to `async def generate(...) -> GenerateResponse` and provide typed models. opened devex/py-sdk#4301 (ci-bot).
ci-bot: issue created: devex/py-sdk#4301 "async context propagation helper + typing fixes" assigned to @sam.
ryan: appreciated. a tiny test that asserts trace ids match across tasks would be great to prevent regressions.
